audit.whatIsWrong: Three level-chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the content whys. win[3] said Skill while whys[3] says 'Her tentacles and sustain own these levels'; win[4] said Skill while whys[4] says the window tilts 'her way'; win[6] said Illaoi while whys[6] says 'Now you flip it'.
audit.why: The 2+ items row is the one row K'Sante genuinely owns — R drags an immobile Illaoi off her tentacles — and the page was giving it to her while the paragraph beneath said the opposite. The packet chart and the mirror both agree.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 flipped to Illaoi and row 6 to K'Sante, each as a matched full/content pair, ratings adjusted, why text rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) Path Maker is described as an 'unstoppable charge' that 'ignores the slam-CC' and means 'her tentacle slams can't CC-lock me' — in three places. Riot's text says K'Sante 'charges up, TAKING REDUCED DAMAGE, then dashes'. There is no unstoppable, no CC immunity. This is the most dangerous error on the page: a player who believes W makes him CC-immune will charge into Leap of Faith's tentacle field and get chain-slammed. (2) Test of Spirit is called 'Her vessel pull' — it rips the spirit and slows; there is no pull. (3) 'Q3 knock-up' again — Ntofo Strikes' second stack pulls.
audit.why: Damage reduction and CC immunity produce opposite decisions. Reduced damage says 'you can eat the burst but you will still be locked down, so W OUT of the field'; unstoppable says 'you can W INTO the field'. The page currently tells the player to do the latter.
audit.corrected: The damage-cut wording put into spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[0] with the CC-immunity claim explicitly retired; Test of Spirit restated as the spirit rip plus slow with its 16/15/14/13/12s in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and dosFull[0].d; the spirit's damage-echo written into dontsFull[1].d; the pull corrected in early.
sources: kit: K'Sante W 'charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes'
kit: Illaoi E 16/15/14/13/12 'rips the spirit... Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and carried a placeholder line.
audit.why: Test of Spirit at 16s rank 1 is the window the whole lane turns on, and Harsh Lesson's flat 4s explains why she can re-engage almost immediately — worth knowing before you decide to stand and trade.
Prophet of an Elder God heals her off every tentacle hit on a champion, and report[8] already carries anti-heal with a Thornmail component early.

edits.before: This is the dangerous stretch — at 4-5 I'm at my tank lane-control peak and can bank small leads trading around her cooldowns, but the second she hits 6 her R carpets the ground in tentacles and her sustain becomes monstrous if I stand in it. My answer is W: I charge it unstoppable so her tentacle slams can't CC-lock me and the damage-resist eats the burst, then I W-knock her out of her own field and Q3 her bare. edits.after: This is the dangerous stretch — at 4-5 she already owns the ground, and the second she hits 6 her R carpets it in tentacles and her sustain becomes monstrous if I stand in it. My answer is W, but read it right: the charge cuts the damage I take, it does not make me CC-immune, so I use it to knock her OUT of her own field and Q3 her bare, never to dive in. Bait her E first — it is 16s at rank 1, and with it down she has no spirit-rip and the field is chip I can walk out of.

edits.before: Neither of us is a real level-1 threat — I only have Q and she's just placing tentacles, so I farm and chip her with the tip of my Q cleave before her tentacle field grows. The trap is her E: if it rips my spirit I'm fighting my own shadow on top of her, so dodge it or never stand near her tentacles when I trade. By level 3 my Q-W combo is online and I can W-shove her off a tentacle to land a Q3 knock-up, but I do not commit inside the field — every tentacle there slams me.
edits.after: Neither of us is a real level-1 threat — I only have Q and she's just placing tentacles, so I farm and chip her with the tip of my Q cleave before her tentacle field grows. The trap is her E: the spirit echoes a share of the damage it takes back onto me, so dodge it or never stand near her tentacles when I trade. By level 3 my Q-W combo is online and I can W-shove her off a tentacle and Q3 to pull her in, but I do not commit inside the field — every tentacle there slams me.

notes: The most dangerous error I found in this slice: three strings describe Path Maker as an 'unstoppable charge' that 'ignores the slam-CC' and means 'her tentacle slams can't CC-lock me'. Riot's text gives Path Maker REDUCED DAMAGE while charging — no unstoppable, no CC immunity. That inverts the advice: reduced damage means W is how you get OUT of Leap of Faith's field, not how you dive into it. Corrected in all three. Test of Spirit was also called a 'pull' (it is a spirit rip that slows) and Ntofo Strikes a 'knock-up' (it pulls). Three chart rows contradicted the packet and the prose beside them. Two things I deliberately did NOT assert: the kit file flags Illaoi's R as 'grounding' and 'untargetable', but Riot's description of Leap of Faith mentions neither — the mirror audit flagged the grounding flag as bogus and I made no claim either way. Also worth carrying if a field opens: Path Maker loses its knockback and stun entirely while All Out is active, so K'Sante's hard CC only exists outside his ultimate.
